Cohort canvas

Carve the 40 heaviest Vaani users along any combination of axes. Filters stack (AND across axes, OR within one). The readout on the right recomputes live for whatever cohort you've carved. Click a card to open the full dossier.

Belief deltas

Where the conversation corrected, contradicted, or extended what the platform believed. correction = platform had "Others"/nothing, voice resolved it. conflict = platform asserts one gender, the dominant voice reads as another. net-new = user is a ghost in order/profile systems; everything we know comes from voice. Respects the cohort filter from view 01.

User deep dive

Everything known about one account, with provenance. Left panel is the platform's ledger; right panel is what the voice transcript revealed, layer by layer, each claim carrying its confidence tier and Hindi evidence span.

Explore / Exploit planner

Rule-based plan built from the dossier + taxonomy: Exploit turns known categories and every stated constraint into ranking inputs; Explore proposes white space grounded only in this user's dossier — named household members, occasions, identity signals, aspirations and unmet asks, never platform popularity; Caution lists what to actively surface or suppress before purchase. Then ask Claude for a judgment-layer plan on demand.

Exploit — known demand, full constraints

Explore — white space

Caution — surface or suppress

Sends this user's dossier, constraints and candidate taxonomy nodes to Claude; returns a personalisation plan (ranking signals, explore bets, caution nudges). Live call — needs network.
